user.title: Connect to ro-etoll
user.description: Use the account from portal.etoll.ro. Complete account verification, select a current profile and add your vehicles on the portal first. ROeID-only or interactive MFA login is not supported.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to eToll again
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current email and password you use at portal.etoll.ro.

reconfigure.title: Change eToll account credentials
reconfigure.description: Enter the email and password you use at portal.etoll.ro.

error.authentication_failed: eToll rejected the credentials. Confirm that login works in the portal and complete any account verification there.
error.auth_unsupported: eToll requires an interactive login or does not allow password authentication for this client. This authentication method is not supported.
error.profile_required: Create and select your current profile in the eToll portal, then try again.
error.cannot_connect: eToll is unreachable, temporarily unavailable, or rate limiting requests. Try again later.
error.invalid_response: eToll returned an unexpected response. The portal API may have changed.
error.invalid_update_interval: Use a whole number from 300 to 86400 seconds.
error.invalid_history: Use a whole number from 1 to 10 years.

abort.already_configured: This eToll account is already configured.
abort.entry_missing: The integration entry no longer exists.

init.title: eToll polling settings
init.description: Poll the portal periodically and choose the invoice history period.
